name: Twelve Permissions #07 — LETTING GO
description: TO STOP. The hardest one, and the one that took longest. Every abandoned project was something I had been proud of at some point. Putting them down without a funeral, no rescue attempt, no one more feature, turned out to be a skill of its own, and the one that made room for anything else. Evidence: The portfolio paused, 12 July 2026. Deterministic seal: every mark derives from sha256 of the canonical event record; re-run the public generator to verify.
